sections.title: key findings — updated after W11 (regular season final)

insights.content: DTC #3 closes out the regular season 11-0 — a perfect run. W11 (6/6) was a 5-0 over LTF and Shi sat out: Emmy played S1, Rachel Glaze took S2, Choi/LaBarre won D1 7-5 6-2, Knotts/Cunningham ground out D2 in a match tiebreak. The depth absorbed a rest day for the team's best player without dropping a set. That's exactly what a 1-seed needs to look like heading into playoffs.

DTC #3 1st at 11-0. Summerlin finishes 2nd at 8-3. Anthem 7-4 (3rd), TPC 6-4 (4th) — but TPC vs DTC #2 (also 6/6) may still be pending, which could shuffle 3rd/4th. The top two teams from each subflight typically advance to playoffs; DTC #3's seed is locked and uncontested.

Shi Oskooi (bl=2.74, r=3.20, 8-0) is the biggest riser in the division — up 0.46 from baseline. Christine LaBarre (bl=3.03, r=3.18, 6-0) and Anna Clark (bl=3.12, r=3.18, 4-1) are both undefeated or near it at high ratings. Darian McCauley (bl=2.92, r=3.09, 5-0) is undefeated. Prexy Tamayo (bl=2.99, r=3.25, 2-2) has the highest rating on the team but limited reps. DTC #3 goes into playoffs with 7 players rated at or above 3.05.

Yari Schieck finishes 7-2 with a rating of 3.07 (bl=3.10) — still just below baseline after the Tayoni upset in W7. She recovered and won her next matches, but her rating hasn't fully bounced back. She's still the right call at S1 in playoffs, but she's not the dominant force she was early in the season. Watch the first set carefully.

DTC #3 rotated 9+ players through the lineup this season — Shi sat out W11, Prexy has only 4 matches, and Glaze/Choi/Knotts/Woods all contributed meaningful wins. That depth means no player is fatigued or over-exposed heading into playoffs. The 3.0A field has no equivalent bench.

DTC #4 leads 3.0B at 9-2 with Whitney Mesa (8-2) right behind. DTC #1 is 7-4. The Sub B playoff seeds are still being determined. DTC #3 will face a Sub B team in the first round — likely Whitney Mesa or DTC #4 depending on seeding format.

sections.title: playoff outlook — DTC #3 enters as Sub A 1st seed

insights.content: DTC #3 is the only undefeated team in 3.0 and holds the best record by 3 matches. They enter as the top seed and should get favorable bracket positioning. The 11-0 run means no team in the field has beaten them — that's real psychological weight.

Lead with Shi/Emmy or Shi/Darian at D1 — the best pair in the division by a wide margin. Yari at S1, Emmy or Anna Clark at S2. Christine/Kara or Christine/Moon at D2/D3. The singles lines are where DTC #3 is most vulnerable; lock in D1 and build from there.

Whitney Mesa (8-2 in Sub B) had the best individual line record per match of any non-DTC team. They're physical, well-coached, and they beat DTC #1 in the regular season. If the bracket puts them opposite DTC #3 in the final, that's the toughest matchup available. Don't overlook them on the way.
